steps.title: Define App Configuration
steps.description: Establish basic metadata parameters in app-meta.json including application name and package namespace structure.

steps.title: Configure Multi-Project Settings
steps.description: Configure settings.gradle to register the main app module and manage repositories for standard dependency resolution.

steps.title: Establish Top-Level Gradle Configuration
steps.description: Define standard top-level build properties and register the Android Gradle plugin version.

steps.title: Configure App Build Settings
steps.description: Implement build.gradle targeting SDK version 34, forcing Java 8 source and target compatibility levels.

steps.title: Create User Interface Layout XML
steps.description: Establish standard fullscreen layout in activity_main.xml consisting of a single WebKit WebView container.

steps.title: Load Single-Page Web Application
steps.description: Construct local asset catalog and save index.html to serve as local offline-capable application interface.

steps.title: Implement WebView Initialization
steps.description: Configure MainActivity.java with basic hardware acceleration, load rules, and title-bar elimination sequence.

steps.title: Enable Javascript and DOM Storage Features
steps.description: Enable settings enabling custom client script execution and DOM local storage API inside WebView container.

steps.title: Implement Native JavaScript Dialog Interfaces
steps.description: Map JavaScript alert() and confirm() dialog triggers to native Android Material AlertDialog windows.

steps.title: Draft Android Application Manifest
steps.description: Register Activity launch permissions, orientation properties, and application theme requirements in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Building My App
steps.description: Perform comprehensive gradle compilation on build tools, validating full compatibility and packaging.
